description: Protect your peace, your character, and your future. #personalgrowthtips #choosepeace #selfleadership #intentionalliving
transcript: I am not a cantankerous person because I have too much to lose. I refuse to be in a position where I have to be reactive or I'm fighting for you to believe my words. I have to convince anyone of who I am. I have dismantled, rebuilt, started over so many times. I understand that slow and steady works for me and I do not have to argue my way through you to prove a point.
